# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- User prefers API tests to run separately from the app: start the app manually, then run Refit tests from a separate Visual Studio window. Do not host the app inside tests.
- Prefer UI modernization changes to stick with Bootstrap 5 patterns or other highly accessible components, without changing core functionality or workflows.
- User prefers admin user listing pages to use a DataTable rather than a custom card list when appropriate.
